question: Can a prediction-only boundary signal selectively correct box-good, support-sufficient mask failures without changing the detector or mask prototypes?

object_definition.target: same-class one-to-one matched prediction with box IoU >= 0.75, baseline mask support >= 0.95, baseline mask IoU < 0.75
object_definition.control: same-class one-to-one matched prediction with box IoU >= 0.75 and baseline mask IoU >= 0.75
object_definition.matching: confidence-first, one-to-one, same class, box IoU >= 0.50

data.gt_usage: post-hoc cohort definition and evaluation only

model.inference_path: official one-to-many predict path with standard mask decode

intervention.name: instance-adaptive logit threshold
intervention.raw_signal: prototype-coefficient mask logit and predicted-box boundary statistics
intervention.policy: stump selected on first half of images; threshold is chosen without GT at inference

gates: The held-out target cohort must improve over threshold 0.
The held-out already-correct control cohort must not lose more than 0.001 mean IoU.
COCOeval segmentation AP must improve in the same direction as target-cohort IoU.
If any gate fails on the expanded evaluation, archive this route as diagnostic-only.
